about: Where droidtop's components come from. kind: mirror (re-hosted here, sources/mirror.json), releases (a GitHub release feed, linked where its maker publishes it, never re-hosted), steam (through droidtop's own Steam sign-in; nothing is published here). engine: bionic runs on droidtop's Windows runtime; linux-glibc needs a glibc userland (droidtop's Linux engine), so droidtop lists it but cannot run it there yet. defaultEnabled: offered without the person turning the source on.
